atena_pick_up.speaker: Atena
atena_pick_up.text: You can pick up rocks using the "LEFT MOUSE" button.

atena_pick_up.speaker: Atena
atena_pick_up.text: You can also throw rocks with the "LEFT MOUSE" button.

atena_pick_up.speaker: Atena
atena_pick_up.text: You can calmly drop rocks with the "RIGHT MOUSE" button.

atena_lever.speaker: Atena2
atena_lever.text: This in front of you is a lever.

atena_lever.speaker: Atena2
atena_lever.text: You can pull the lever using the "LEFT MOUSE" button.

atena_lever.speaker: Atena2
atena_lever.text: "Give me a lever long enough and a fulcrum on which to place it, and I shall move the world."

atena_lever.speaker: Atena2
atena_lever.text: Give it a try, maybe something happens!
